title: Design System: CF Platform Flow Control Desk

headline.purpose: The current Flow title in the workspace header.

title.purpose: Brand, inspector, and compact section titles.

label.purpose: Controls, gates, stages, and compact metadata.

mono.purpose: IDs, hashes, revisions, and version evidence.

shadows.name: segment-selection
shadows.purpose: Lifts the selected chat/canvas segment from its recessed track.

shadows.name: enamel-lamp
shadows.purpose: Gives small status lamps their enamel face and physical edge.

shadows.name: enamel-lamp-large
shadows.purpose: The larger lamp in the test gate.

shadows.name: node-rest
shadows.purpose: Separates draggable nodes from mineral paper.

shadows.name: node-engaged
shadows.purpose: Signals node hover and operational engagement.

shadows.name: node-selected-ring
shadows.purpose: Adds a clear orange selection signal around the engaged node.

shadows.name: entry-marker
shadows.purpose: Anchors the route origin above the canvas.

shadows.name: toast-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates transient operational feedback from the workspace.

motion.name: ease-route
motion.purpose: Shared deceleration for lifts, reveals, and drawer travel.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Node border/shadow feedback and orange creation fill.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: One-pixel control lift; the new-Flow control uses 240ms.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: Left and right responsive drawer translation.

motion.name: intro-reveal
motion.purpose: First-run invitation fade, deblur, and 8px rise.

motion.name: route-running
motion.purpose: Moves the 9/7 dash pattern on a running route.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses all animation and transition durations when reduced motion is preferred.

components.name: Publish Button
components.description: The gated clearance action, enabled only after a passing Flow test.
components.css: .ds-btn-publish{display:inline-flex;height:34px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:0 12px;color:#fff;background:var(--green);border:1px solid #255d44;border-radius:7px;font:720 12px/1.5 Aptos,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background 140ms ease,transform 220ms var(--ease)}.ds-btn-publish svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-btn-publish:hover:not(:disabled){background:#367f5e;transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-btn-publish:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(0)}.ds-btn-publish:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-publish:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.46}

components.name: Signal Button
components.description: Starts testing or opens the next route-building action that requires attention.
components.css: .ds-btn-signal{display:inline-flex;height:34px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:0 12px;color:#fff;background:var(--orange);border:1px solid var(--orange-deep);border-radius:7px;font:720 12px/1.5 Aptos,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 140ms ease,background 140ms ease,transform 220ms var(--ease)}.ds-btn-signal svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-btn-signal:hover:not(:disabled){background:#d9793c;transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-btn-signal:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(0)}.ds-btn-signal:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-signal:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.46}

components.name: Standard Button
components.description: The default compact action for canvas, inspector, and toolbar operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-standard{display:inline-flex;height:34px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:0 12px;color:var(--text);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:7px;font:720 12px/1.5 Aptos,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 140ms ease,background 140ms ease,transform 220ms var(--ease)}.ds-btn-standard:hover:not(:disabled){background:#fff;border-color:#a9a292;transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-btn-standard:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(0)}.ds-btn-standard:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-standard:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.46}

components.name: Inspector Input
components.description: A compact white field for Flow and node properties in the inspection drawer.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:5px;color:#59635b;font:720 11px/1.5 Aptos,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif}.ds-field input{width:100%;height:34px;padding:0 10px;color:var(--text);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;font:400 14px/1.5 Aptos,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong)}.ds-field input:focus,.ds-field input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--orange);outline:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(206,111,50,.14)}

components.name: Draft State Chip
components.description: A text-backed lifecycle signal for the current draft or passed state.
components.css: .ds-draft-state{display:inline-flex;height:24px;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 8px;color:#735227;background:var(--amber-soft);border:1px solid #ddc996;border-radius:12px;font:700 11px/1.5 Aptos,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}.ds-draft-lamp{width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--amber);border-radius:50%}.ds-draft-state:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Current Flow Navigation Item
components.description: The active route in the deep-ink Flow register, with lamp, metadata, and orange rail.
components.css: .ds-flow-item{position:relative;display:grid;width:100%;grid-template-columns:12px minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;padding:10px 9px;color:#fff;text-align:left;background:#2a382e;border:0;border-radius:8px;font-family:Aptos,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-flow-item::before{position:absolute;top:10px;bottom:10px;left:-10px;width:3px;content:"";background:var(--orange);border-radius:0 3px 3px 0}.ds-flow-item:hover{background:#304035}.ds-flow-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:2px}.ds-flow-item strong{display:block;overflow:hidden;font-size:13px;font-weight:680;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-flow-item small{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#9aa69c;font-size:11px}.ds-route-lamp{width:8px;height:8px;margin-top:5px;background:#bd7a3c;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.42);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.55),0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}

components.name: Goal Composer
components.description: The primary first-view input, pairing a goal textarea with honest runtime context and an orange send control.
components.html: 目标 Runtime · connector 接入后生效
components.css: .ds-composer{width:min(100%,790px);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 9px 26px rgba(53,58,49,.11);font-family:Aptos,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif}.ds-composer textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:72px;max-height:160px;padding:14px 16px 6px;resize:none;color:var(--text);background:transparent;border:0;outline:0;font:400 14px/1.5 inherit}.ds-composer textarea::placeholder{color:#747e76}.ds-composer-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 8px 8px 12px}.ds-runtime{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.ds-runtime-lamp{width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%}.ds-runtime select{padding:3px 22px 3px 2px;color:var(--text);background:transparent;border:0;font:700 12px/1.5 inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-runtime select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:2px}.ds-composer-footer small{flex:1;color:var(--faint);font-size:10px}.ds-composer-send{display:inline-grid;width:34px;height:34px;padding:0;place-items:center;color:#fff;background:var(--orange);border:1px solid var(--orange-deep);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}.ds-composer-send svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-composer-send:hover{background:#d9793c}.ds-composer-send:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:2px}.ds-composer-send:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

components.name: Flow Route Node
components.description: The signature draggable inspection card with capability identity, route order, and enamel state.
components.css: .ds-flow-node{position:relative;display:grid;width:184px;min-height:112px;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto;padding:0;color:var(--text);text-align:left;background:#fff;border:1px solid #bcb5a5;border-radius:11px;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(46,52,45,.11);font-family:Aptos,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;cursor:grab;transition:box-shadow 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease}.ds-flow-node:hover{border-color:#938b7b;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(46,52,45,.15)}.ds-flow-node:active{cursor:grabbing}.ds-flow-node:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:2px}.ds-flow-node.ds-selected{border-color:var(--orange);box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(46,52,45,.15),0 0 0 2px rgba(206,111,50,.2)}.ds-node-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 10px 7px;color:var(--muted);border-bottom:1px solid #e3dfd5;font-size:11px;font-weight:760;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-node-kind{display:grid;width:22px;height:22px;place-items:center;color:#fff;background:var(--blue);border-radius:5px;font-size:8.5px}.ds-node-order{margin-left:auto;color:var(--faint);font-size:9px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-node-body{min-width:0;padding:10px 11px 8px}.ds-node-body strong{display:-webkit-box;overflow:hidden;font-size:15px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-.01em;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2}.ds-node-body small{display:block;margin-top:4px;overflow:hidden;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-node-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 10px;color:var(--muted);background:#f1eee5;border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;font-size:11px}.ds-node-lamp{width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--green);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.65),0 2px 4px rgba(30,40,32,.24)}.ds-port{position:absolute;top:50%;width:12px;height:12px;margin-top:-6px;background:#f7f4ea;border:3px solid #6c786f;border-radius:50%}.ds-in{left:-7px}.ds-out{right:-7px}

components.name: Test Gate
components.description: The explicit release gate pairing an enamel lamp with readable pass/fail consequences.
components.html:
测试已通过，可以发布

每次修改节点、顺序或配置后测试结果都会失效。
components.css: .ds-test-gate{padding:12px;background:#ece8dc;border:1px solid #d2ccbd;border-radius:8px;font-family:Aptos,"Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif}.ds-test-gate-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.ds-test-lamp{width:12px;height:12px;flex:0 0 auto;background:#949b94;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.65),0 2px 5px rgba(35,45,37,.28)}.ds-test-gate.ds-passed .ds-test-lamp{background:var(--green)}.ds-test-gate:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong)}.ds-test-gate:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--orange);outline-offset:2px}.ds-test-gate strong{display:block;color:var(--text);font-size:11px}.ds-test-gate p{margin:3px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}

narrative.overview:
CF Platform behaves like an interlocking signal desk: every Flow is a route that must be stated, reviewed, manually composed, tested, cleared, and archived. The visual world is operate-mode—calm, precise, reliable, restrained, and professional—with a deep ink-green route register, a mineral-paper work surface, exact route lines, enamel indicators, and a white inspection drawer.

The material language is functional rather than nostalgic. Ink marks persistent navigation and infrastructure; paper holds the editable work; enamel lamps expose machine state; orange signals present attention or motion; green means a route is clear to publish. The canvas grid is permitted only as the coordinate surface of the Flow editor. There are no shipping raster assets.
keyCharacteristics: Full-height route register, work surface, and inspection drawer arranged as one control desk.
Warm mineral neutrals and dark green ink instead of generic gray-white dashboard chrome.
Sparse enamel state lamps paired with text labels, borders, and gate copy.
A wide, zoomable route canvas with readable nodes and precise orthogonal connections.
Short, purposeful motion that reports state without suggesting “AI magic.”

rules.name: The Signal Has One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Orange means attention, selection, or motion; green means passed, healthy, or publishable; amber means waiting or blocked; red means failed or destructive. Never swap these roles for variety.

rules.name: The Lamp-and-Label Rule
rules.body: State color is always accompanied by text, a border change, a position in the lifecycle, or an icon; an enamel lamp never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The Paper Is Work Rule
rules.body: The faint square grid belongs only to the actual Flow canvas. All other paper surfaces remain quiet.

rules.name: The Operations Type Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and density, not oversized headings; reserve the fluid display size for the empty-state invitation.

rules.name: The Evidence Face Rule
rules.body: Monospace identifies machine evidence—IDs, hashes, revisions, and versions—not ordinary UI labels.

rules.name: The Readable-Zoom Rule
rules.body: Node header, kind, order, title, subtitle, and footer text multiply their base size by `--inverse-zoom` so labels remain visually readable while the 1200×680 route plane scales from 60% to 140%.

rules.name: The Persistent Route Rule
rules.body: Keep the current Flow visible through the register, title, route code, lifecycle, or drawer context; no operation should make the user lose which route they are changing.

rules.name: The Work Surface Rule
rules.body: Conversation is a focused reading column; composition is a wide spatial canvas. Do not force both into a generic card grid.

rules.name: The Drawer Threshold Rule
rules.body: Collapse the inspector at 980px and the route register at 720px; do not squeeze either into unusably narrow persistent columns.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Borders establish permanent hierarchy; shadows are reserved for editable objects, active selections, drawers, and transient feedback.

rules.name: The Enamel Geometry Rule
rules.body: Circles are signals, ports, indices, or route origins. Ordinary content lives in restrained rounded rectangles.

rules.name: The Measured Corner Rule
rules.body: Do not apply one universal radius. Radius increases modestly with object scale and softness, from 5px capability marks to the 14px emblem.

dos: Do treat each Flow as a route with visible draft, running, passed, failed, blocked, and published evidence.
Do use the ink rail, mineral paper, inspection white, exact route lines, and enamel lamps as a single functional material system.
Do keep goal entry, test, and gated publish as the dominant actions in their respective lifecycle stages.
Do preserve text labels, focus treatment, keyboard reordering, focus-trapped drawers, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep route-node text readable across the implemented 60–140% zoom range with inverse scaling.
Do use the 28px grid only inside the real Flow coordinate surface.
donts: Don't turn the product into a generic chat page or a general-purpose node administration dashboard.
Don't replace the mineral-paper and ink world with a generic gray-white developer dashboard.
Don't use neon “AI magic,” glassmorphism, or luminous gradient effects to imply intelligence.
Don't create high-saturation card mosaics or let status colors compete as decoration.
Don't place decorative grids outside the actual Flow canvas.
Don't use raster atmosphere or ornamental imagery; the shipped system has no raster assets.
